note: Crafts of the Somatic Reaches/Cogitarium (body_mind axis). Soma is the body-pole tradition (the physical masteries, the body as instrument); Noesis the mind-pole (mental disciplines, memory-palaces, thought as force). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with Somatics/Cogitants. Both drift the wielder toward their pole; the perfected athlete-scholar is where they co-fire, the disembodied Cogitant where mind wins absolutely. axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016 — the last of the six near-axis traditions.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.narrationHints: Past the wall, and the body finds more.
abilities.description: Push the body past exhaustion, pain or shock — closing some of what is open, hitting harder for it, and at its height refusing to stop at all.

tree.name: Embrace the Suck
tree.grants: ⛔ IGNORE PAIN, FATIGUE, COLD OR SHOCK FOR A DECISIVE BURST — and the quality of what you are doing does not fall while it holds. ⚠️ IT ALSO CLOSES SOME OF WHAT IS ALREADY OPEN: a small heal, and a soak against the next blows on top of the resist.
tree.cannot: ⛔ Damage ignored is applied when it ends.
tree._cannotWas: The body remembers the debt. What you ignore is still there when it ends.

tree.name: Third Wind
tree.grants: ⛔ PUSH PAST EXHAUSTION AND COME OUT STRONGER THAN RESTED — no daily limit, your blows land harder for it, and the state holds inside a fight rather than only across a march.
tree.cannot: ⛔ Damage ignored is applied when it ends; the empowered state ends with it.
tree._cannotWas: You are borrowing from tomorrow, and tomorrow collects with interest.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS EMPOWERED ATTACKS AND NO DAILY LIMIT. What you find is not simply more of what you had — you are stronger and faster than your own rested self, and your blows land harder for it. ⚠️ AND THE DURATION NOW APPLIES INSIDE A FIGHT, not just across a march.

tree.name: Dream Breath
tree.grants: ⛔ GRANTS SOAK WORTH A SHARE OF YOUR MAXIMUM HEALTH, AND HEALS HALF THAT AMOUNT OUTRIGHT. The body does not stop until the work is done, and it tends itself as it runs — bleeding slows, shock recedes.
tree.cannot: ⛔ All damage ignored while it runs is applied when it ends.
tree._cannotWas: ⚠️ HELD OFF IS NOT HEALED. Everything deferred arrives at once when you stop, and it arrives worse.

crit.success: You find more than you spent, and everyone near you steadies for seeing it.

failure.text: There was nothing left to find. The debt arrives now instead of later.

rankDeltas.delta: find breath and strength past where the body had none — TWICE IN ONE DAY, at a cost
rankDeltas._prose: ⚠️ `uses` IS A NAMED AXIS, NOT AN ENGINE FIELD — RULED PROSE 2026-08-28. Per `craft_mechanics.operativeAxis` (SNG-263 r4 — CCode's note, correcting his own closed vocabulary after Aevi's blazeborn pilot broke it: 12 crafts declared 18 distinct axes, 10 unanticipated): a named axis is 'real, authored, SHOWN TO THE PLAYER, and scaled in the craft's own prose at each rank and intensity, but NOT arithmetic the engine performs'. ⛔ IT EXTENDS NOTHING AND THAT IS CORRECT. Do not invent a field for it, and do not 'fix' it to a nearby one — `uses` says something no engine field says.

intensity.surge: double it; THE BODY IS BORROWING FROM TOMORROW, AND TOMORROW COLLECTS WITH INTEREST

HELD OFF IS NOT HEALED — everything deferred ARRIVES AT ONCE when you stop

sectFlavour.somatic: TRAINED BREATH AND HEARTBEAT — you know exactly what you are spending.
sectFlavour.mason: THE NEXT CORRECT ACTION TAKEN, not inspiration. Absorbs Long Haul.

abilities.name: Perfect Motion
abilities.narrationHints: The body does exactly and only what's needed, flawlessly.
abilities.description: Execute a physical act with impossible precision and economy — dodge what you saw coming, waste no motion, and at its height act before you have decided to.
abilities.notFor: Feats past the body's true ceiling; thought-work.

tree.name: Acrobatics
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE PHYSICAL ACT AT THE EDGE OF THE POSSIBLE, EXECUTED EXACTLY — a landing, a catch, a cut, a climb. ⚠️ AND IT EVADES: use it to take yourself out of the path of a blow you saw coming.
tree.cannot: One act. The true limit still holds, and it costs the body.

tree.name: Unwasted Motion
tree.grants: ⛔ MOVE WITH TOTAL ECONOMY — every motion does only what it must. Blocks cost you nothing, you are never out of position, and you do not tire from moving well.
tree.cannot: Efficiency is not power. A perfect motion still loses to a stronger one.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS ECONOMY AS A CONDITION. Every motion does only what it must — blocks cost you nothing, you are never out of position, and you do not tire from moving well.

tree.name: Motion Without Thought
tree.grants: ⛔ THE BODY ACTS BEFORE THE DECISION — A SECOND PHYSICAL ACTION THIS ROUND, and the strikes come as a flurry: stance and breath and timing arriving together, each blow set up by the last. ⚠️ IT WOUNDS FAR PAST WHAT THE SAME ARM COULD DO UNTRAINED — not because you are stronger, but because nothing is wasted and nothing is telegraphed.
tree.cannot: ⛔ Once per round. The body chooses — if you have trained it badly, it will do that beautifully.
tree._imposes: ⛔ SNG-513. ⚠️ The body acts before the decision — the foe loses the exchange they had planned.

mechanic.note: AN EIGHTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC — EFFICIENT: not armour, not absence, not misdirection, but never making a wasted or wrong motion. Uses Erik's evasion model; zero soak because a perfect motion still takes the blow it cannot avoid.

crit.success: The body acts before the decision and gets it right — you are already elsewhere when the blow arrives.
crit.failure: The body acts before the decision. You have trained it badly and it does that beautifully.

rankDeltas.delta: NO MOTION YOU MAKE IS WASTED — every step, block and reach does exactly and only what it must
SPECIAL: THE BODY ACTS CORRECTLY BEFORE THE MIND KNOWS THERE WAS A DECISION — and it is right

intensity.conserve: move cleanly — half the efficiency, and it costs the body nothing
intensity.surge: double it; EFFICIENCY IS NOT POWER — a perfect motion still loses to a strong enough one

EFFICIENCY IS NOT POWER — a perfect motion still loses to a strong enough one
THE BODY CHOOSES — if you have trained it badly, IT WILL DO THAT PERFECTLY

Lasts about four hours. r2 makes every motion cost nothing; ⛔ r3 GRANTS A SECOND PHYSICAL ACTION AND A FLURRY OF STRIKES that wound past what the arm alone could. ⚠️ Efficiency is not power — a perfect motion still loses to a strong enough one.

sectFlavour.mason: ECONOMY OF EFFORT LEARNED FROM MATERIAL — nothing spent that the work did not need.

abilities.name: Memory-Palace
abilities.narrationHints: They go still and their eyes track across nothing, left to right, like someone reading. Then they tell you where they have seen that man before.
abilities.description: Search your own memory for something that bears on what you are doing — and let it sharpen the attempt.
abilities.notFor: Wisdom; presence in the body it forgets.

tree.name: Cross-Reference
tree.grants: ⛔ SEARCH YOUR OWN ATTENDED MEMORY FOR SOMETHING THAT BEARS ON WHAT YOU ARE DOING — a similar lock, a face, a passage read once, a fight fought before. ⚠️ MECHANICALLY: roll to determine how much it helps; on a success your next attempt gains a bonus to succeed AND a widened crit range.
tree.cannot: One attempt, and you must have attended to something relevant. A subject you have never encountered gives you nothing.

tree.name: Whole House
tree.grants: ⛔ SEARCH YOUR OWN ATTENDED MEMORY AND THE SEARCH NO LONGER FAILS. It always finds something usable, and the bonus to your next attempt lands at its maximum rather than being rolled for.
tree.cannot: Still your own memory. It takes a quiet moment you may not have in a fight.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS RELIABILITY AND CEILING. The search no longer fails to find something usable, and the bonus lands at its maximum rather than being rolled for.

tree.name: Borrowed Room
tree.grants: ⛔ SEARCH SOMEONE ELSE'S MEMORY. Enter a willing — or unresisting — mind and read their route, their language, their trade. ⚠️ FOR ONE ATTEMPT YOU MAY USE A SKILL THEY HAVE AND YOU DO NOT, at their rank.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ A resisting mind can refuse and a hostile one costs you. You get what THEY attended to, including what they were wrong about.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS SOMEONE ELSE'S. Enter a willing — or unresisting — mind and search THEIR memory: their route, their language, their trade. ⚠️ FOR ONE ATTEMPT YOU MAY USE A SKILL THEY HAVE AND YOU DO NOT, at their rank.

abilities.name: Skydancer
abilities.narrationHints: The body treats the air like ground — a leap becomes a bound becomes something the earth stopped being able to stop.
abilities.description: Take steps on open air — cross what has no bottom, climb what has no holds, and come down from any height under control.
abilities.notFor: Sustained hovering or true flight (it's bursts, momentum-bound); carrying heavy loads aloft.

tree.name: Air-Step
tree.grants: ⛔ TAKE A STEP ON NOTHING. One footfall in open air per bound — cross a gap with no bottom, run a vertical wall for its full height, drop three storeys and keep moving. ⚠️ WHERE LOOSE-LIMBED LEAVES THE GROUND AND RETURNS TO IT, THIS DOES NOT NEED GROUND AT ALL.
tree.cannot: Each step must be taken while still moving. Stop, and you fall from wherever you are.

tree.name: Long Air
tree.grants: ⛔ CHAIN STEPS ON OPEN AIR WITHOUT TOUCHING DOWN — cross a canyon, ascend a tower face unbroken, or hold a position in open air long enough to fight from it.
tree.cannot: You must keep moving. Fighting from the air costs a step per exchange.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS DURATION AND HEIGHT. Chain the steps without touching down — cross a canyon, ascend a tower face unbroken, hold a position in open air long enough to fight from it.

tree.name: Carry the Line
tree.grants: ⛔ TAKE A ROPE, A LINE OR A PERSON UP WITH YOU on steps of open air — and come down under control from any height at all.
tree.cannot: One passenger or one line. A falling body you catch is a passenger.
tree._gainNote: ⚠️ A passenger is targets; controlled descent from any height is quality.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS OTHERS AND DESCENT. Take a rope, a line or a person up with you — and come down under control from any height at all.

abilities.name: Working Model
abilities.narrationHints: They do not describe it. The shape is simply there between everyone, and the argument that had been going for an hour resolves in four words because now people are pointing at the same thing.
abilities.description: Hold a thing's true working shape in mind — and put it where others can see it, turn it, and point at the part that is wrong.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT SHOWS HOW A THING WORKS, NEVER WHAT IT IS FOR — you will hold the mill and its race exactly and learn nothing about who profits from it. ⚠️ AND NOT LIVING SYSTEMS IN MOTION: a body at rest models fine, a body fighting does not. ⛔ It builds nothing — the model is held in the mind and the mill is still broken when you stop. Nor does it work on anything whose parts you have not seen: it reasons from structure, and structure you have not observed is a guess.

tree.name: Single Thing
tree.grants: ⛔ HOLD ONE THING'S WORKING SHAPE AND SHOW IT — a lock, a brace, a splint, a door, a cart-repair, a small room. ⚠️ IT IS NOT A DESCRIPTION. The shape stands where the others can see it, and they can point at the part they mean.
tree.cannot: One object or one small space at a time. You must be able to examine it.

tree.name: Whole Working
tree.grants: ⛔ HOLD AND SHOW A WORKING SYSTEM — a machine with parts moving against each other, a building, a body, a workshop yard. ⚠️ You can run it forward and let people watch it fail in the place it is going to fail.
tree.cannot: You must have access to the whole of it; a system half-hidden is modelled half-wrong.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS SYSTEMS AND COMPOUNDS. A machine with parts that move against each other, a building, a body, a workshop yard — anything whose pieces have to agree. Diagnose its faults and redesign it from the inside.

tree.name: Modelled Country
tree.grants: ⛔ HOLD A WORKING WITH MANY INTERACTING PARTS — a mill and its race, a fortification and its approaches — AND HAND THE MODEL TO OTHERS: anyone you brief can build their piece correctly without understanding the whole. ⚠️ THAT LAST IS A PROJECT: it banks per tick and completes on a threshold.
tree.cannot: One such working at a time, and you must be able to get around the whole of it.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ ADDS COMPLEXITY AND DISTRICT SCALE. A mill and its race, a fortification and its approaches, a quarter's drainage. Held entire, and rebuilt entire.
tree._rebalance: ⚠️ Was the third scope-gain in a row for this skill. Delegation is what a modeller actually does at that scale.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS COMPLEXITY AND DELEGATION. Hold a working with many interacting parts — a mill and its race, a fortification and its approaches — and hand the model to others: anyone you brief can build their piece correctly without understanding the whole.

tree.name: Undivided
tree.grants: Attention at a weight a body cannot be looked at under. Things stop. Hearts are things. AND YOU KEEP YOURSELF NOW: the wielder no longer stops running their own body to do it, and can act while the regard holds.
tree.cannot: Still ONE TARGET, still line of sight, and a trained mind still knows what you are doing and who is doing it. The Discarnate reach this rank and then keep going, which is how they stop coming back.

abilities._backlashTree_20260902: ⛔ OI-20 / R18 — BACKLASH SCALES WITH RANK, THE WAY HARM ALREADY DOES. `backlashRung` was a single flat top-level value: a craft turned on you identically at rank 1 and rank 3, even though at rank 3 it is doing lethal work. ✅ RULE: the top-level value is the CEILING (identical in meaning to `harmRung`, per R5-corrected and `intent.js:34`), and each craft's OWN authored offset is applied per rank — `backlash[r] = max(none, harm[r] − (ceilingHarm − ceilingBacklash))`. ⚠️ THE OFFSET IS PER-CRAFT AND WAS NOT FLATTENED: most lethal crafts backlash at `damaging` (offset 2), but `found_fault`, `offered_mouth`, `plain_weight`, `sudden_work` and `thinned_veil` backlash at `incapacitating` (offset 1) — an authored judgement that some crafts turn on the wielder harder. ✅ The rule REPRODUCES each craft's authored top-level exactly at its top rank and scales down below it. ⛔ CONSEQUENCE WORTH NAMING: at rank 1 most of these now have NO backlash at all — a novice's craft does not turn on them — which is Erik's standing correction that penalties must not land hardest on low-level players.
